orders.rationale: PHC Wayanad-01 can spare 99 tablets (2 batches: B009-HC001 (42 tablets, 372 days), B010-HC001 (57 tablets, 402 days)) while PHC Wayanad-02 holds 26 tablets against a 100% chance of running short within its 12-day resupply window. Moving them 11 km costs ₹618 and averts an expected 69.1 tablets of unmet demand, cutting stock-out risk to 4%.

PHC Wayanad-01 can spare 11 vials (batch B012-HC001, expires in 478 days) while PHC Wayanad-02 holds 5 vials against a 84% chance of running short within its 12-day resupply window. Moving them 11 km costs ₹618 and averts an expected 4.5 vials of unmet demand, cutting stock-out risk to 5%.

DH Wayanad-01 needs 14 ampoules of Atropine Sulphate and a vehicle is already going there from District Warehouse Wayanad with other stock. Adding 1 ampoule (batch OPEN-DW001, expires in 212 days) to that run costs ₹60 in picking and handling rather than a second ₹504 vehicle, and averts an expected 0.9 ampoules of unmet demand, cutting stock-out risk from 94% to 88%.

PHC Kozhikode-04 can spare 2 vials (2 batches: B006-HC004 (1 vial, 469 days), B004-HC004 (1 vial, 472 days)) while DH Wayanad-01 holds 6 vials against a 100% chance of running short within its 10-day resupply window. Moving them 87 km costs ₹2,023 and averts an expected 2.0 vials of unmet demand, cutting stock-out risk to 98%.

100 tablets at District Warehouse Wayanad (batch OPEN-DW001, expires in 61 days) cannot be used there before expiry. DH Wayanad-01 dispenses about 6.6 tablets a day and will consume them well before expiry. Moving them 3 km costs ₹504 and saves ₹1,100 of stock from being written off.

DH Wayanad-01 needs 602 tablets of Primaquine and a vehicle is already going there from District Warehouse Wayanad with other stock. Adding 100 tablets (batch OPEN-DW001, expires in 395 days) to that run costs ₹60 in picking and handling rather than a second ₹504 vehicle, and averts an expected 100.0 tablets of unmet demand, cutting stock-out risk from 100% to 100%.

DH Wayanad-01 needs 209 vials of Ceftriaxone and a vehicle is already going there from District Warehouse Wayanad with other stock. Adding 1 vial (batch OPEN-DW001, expires in 153 days) to that run costs ₹60 in picking and handling rather than a second ₹504 vehicle, and averts an expected 1.0 vials of unmet demand, cutting stock-out risk from 95% to 95%.
